references.role: exact 1+1 dimensional spectral and scattering analysis

theorem_contract.essential_spectrum: (-inf,-n] union [n,inf), purely absolutely continuous off the finite point spectrum
theorem_contract.factorization: H_n^2=diag(A_n_star A_n,A_n A_n_star) with shape invariance
theorem_contract.point_spectrum: one chiral zero mode and simple pairs +/-sqrt(j(2n-j)), j=1,...,n-1
theorem_contract.scattering: both scalar partners and the Dirac kink are reflectionless at integer n
theorem_contract.self_adjointness: H_n is self-adjoint on H1 and generates a unitary group
theorem_contract.thresholds: +/-n are resonant but not L2 eigenvalues
